scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy --config cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc

DB.description: Database for accounts, profiles, watch history and watchlist.

APP_SECRET.description: A private secret code shared only with your Kodi devices. Use a long random value and enter the same value when Movie Hub asks for your secret code.

ENC_KEY.description: Encryption key that protects stored API keys. Enter any long random string (30+ characters). Keep it secret; you won't need it again.
